_notes: The fleet is this file. One lane = one sequential episode stream = one game account;
parallelism is exactly the number of enabled lanes. Edit while run-fleet is up: it
re-reads every 60s. enabled:false drains a lane (its roster process is SIGTERMed at
the next episode boundary — the running episode finishes); enabled:true or a new
lane spawns one. A malformed edit never kills running lanes: the fleet complains and
Lane policy: OpenCode Zen and OpenRouter lanes carry FREE models only, one stream
per provider (their free tiers are pooled per upstream provider — two streams just
starve each other and trip the same rate limits twice). claude models run ONLY via
the claude-subscription driver, never through an openai-driver lane.
Entries use the exact per-entry schema of roster JSONs (model, driver, effort,
character, race, class, episodeMs, ...). account comes from the lane. A lane may
point at a rosterFile instead of inline entries. Run ids derive as
fleet-<lane>-<model-slug>[-<effort>]-<date> so fleet runs never collide with
sub-opus is the burn switch: flip it to true when there is subscription budget to
burn, back to false to stop after the episode in flight.
